title: Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī
transliterated_title: Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī (A Treatise Presented to ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn b. Bāysunghur)
genre: brief hadith treatise on iḥsān-īmān-islām and the five fundamentals

date.basis: Melvin-Koushki states completion on this date without an asterisk; the MS Majlis 10196 copy is undated, so the source of the date is not given in the entry.

place: not stated (the introduction complains of his treatment in Herat; the timeline places him in exile in this period)
occasion: a treatise presented to ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn; the introduction complains of harsh treatment in Herat
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196/47 ff. 371b-73b, 375b-82a (the only copy listed; undated).
summary: A brief treatment of the hadith on iḥsān, īmān and islām, with the wisdom of the five fundamentals of practice and attention to Hanbali and Shafiʿi practice; states that his family has always been Shafiʿi.
